evidence.note: Product-safe starter graph for a clean Praxis checkout.

nodes.name: Praxis
nodes.summary: Agent-agnostic knowledge-to-skill framework combining source capture, retrieval, graph memory, skill packaging, and evaluation.

nodes.name: Source Capture
nodes.summary: Durable capture of source content, metadata, provenance, and summaries before provisional memory or graph updates are applied.

nodes.name: Hybrid Retrieval
nodes.summary: Retrieval that combines semantic similarity, keyword matches, and graph hints.

nodes.name: SkillGraph
nodes.summary: Graph of sources, concepts, skills, practices, tools, benchmarks, claims, and evidence-backed relationships.

nodes.name: Agent Skill
nodes.summary: Portable procedural capability package that can include instructions, references, scripts, tests, and assets.

nodes.name: Knowledge-to-Skill Loop
nodes.summary: Lifecycle where trusted sources become indexed memory, graph relationships, practical skills, and evaluated agent behavior.

edges.summary: Praxis is organized around turning captured knowledge into reusable agent capability.
Captured source text can be chunked and indexed for retrieval.
Captured sources can provide evidence for provisional graph nodes and edges.
Graph relationships help decide which procedural skill updates are justified.
